text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,800.6, up 1.12% for the day and 2.61% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.8% (1.49% five‑day). Advances (247) barely outpaced declines (243), giving a breadth score of 69.9 and a “healthy” market tone. Bank Nifty led the rally, gaining 2.49% (5.9% five‑day) to 64,635.2, and the India VIX, a volatility gauge, jumped 7.51% to 17.32, indicating higher fear despite the rise.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) added INR 10,308.42 crore today, extending a 17‑day buying streak, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold INR 4,859.8 crore, marking three consecutive days of outflows. Leading sectors were banks (PSU, private, and financial services), realty, auto and FMCG, whereas oil & gas, healthcare and IT lagged. Options data show a put‑call ratio of 1.67 for Nifty (more puts than calls) and a max‑pain level near 25,500, with resistance (“call wall”) at 26,000 and support (“put wall”) at 24,500.

Watch the Nifty’s 25,651.53 pivot (P) and the 25,494.27 S1 level; a break below S1 could test the 24,500 put wall. Bank Nifty’s pivot at 63,971.52 and S1 at 63,262.23 are also key. Keep an eye on the USD‑INR at 92.66 (down 0.86%) and crude oil at $88.58, as any further rupee strength or oil price moves may influence the next session.
